pages.text: Implant organs into the body.$(br2)$(bold)Implant$(): target slot free + organ matches the slot; costs $(bold)3 solids + 20,000 life energy$(), 4 seconds.$(bold)Extract$(): costs $(bold)1 solid + 5,000 energy$(), the organ returns to your inventory.$(br)Don't leave or lose resources mid-operation.

$(bold)Rejection$() is the price of implantation: base value comes from gene quality, creature group and integrity; native organs are 0.$(br2)Rejection $(bold)grows over time$(): rate × 100/adaptation, doubled below adaptation 60, and ×1.6 for strong genes (End/Dragon).$(br2)Enemy pairs lock rejection to max, disable the organ and backfire with an explosion - $(2)synergistic organs and the Life Set$() are the future.
